why.heading: Built for businesses that don't need a pitch deck.
why.prose1: Most deal platforms are designed for startups: high-growth companies raising money, burning cash, betting on a future. Bottega is built for the opposite: businesses with cash flow, real clients, and years behind them.
why.prose2: These businesses don't need hype. They need a clear presentation: financials framed properly, story told well, so the right buyer can recognise what they're looking at. That's what Bottega does.
why.stat1Label: The only platform focused on these two markets
why.stat2Label: We curate and review every deal page, not an algorithm
why.stat3Label: Financials and sensitive info protected until you decide to share

problem.heading: Selling a business is hard when you've never done it before.
problem.card1Title: How do I explain my business to a stranger?
problem.card1Body: You know your business inside out. But explaining it to an outside buyer (its financials, its strengths, its potential) is a different skill entirely.
problem.card2Title: Where do serious buyers actually look?
problem.card2Body: Serious buyers exist. But they don't browse classifieds. They rely on curated sources, trusted advisors, and platforms that do the screening for them.
problem.card3Title: What if my staff find out before I'm ready?
problem.card3Body: You don't want your competitors knowing you're selling. You don't want tyre-kickers calling your staff. You want control.

problem.heading: Most deal presentations don't do justice to the business.
problem.prose:
A PDF sent cold. A Dropbox link with unstructured financials. A listing on a classifieds site with three lines of description. Buyers scroll past. Conversations never start.

You've done the work to represent the seller. Bottega makes sure buyers can see it.

features.feat4Desc: Each deal gets a clean URL you can share in your own outreach. Works as your deal summary, not a replacement for your process.

problem.heading: Buying a small business takes longer than it should.
problem.prose1: Finding a quality deal is hard enough. When you do find one, you spend weeks chasing the seller for documentation. Then more weeks finding the right lawyer, the right accountant. Professionals who actually know SME transactions in this market.
problem.prose2: And sometimes, after months of effort and real money spent, the business simply wasn't worth buying.
problem.prose3: That's the reality most buyers face in Southern Europe. Bottega is built to change it.
problem.pain1Quote: Three months and nothing to show for it.
problem.pain1Desc: Time lost chasing documentation, assembling professionals, running due diligence, only to walk away.
problem.pain2Quote: The listing had three lines and a phone number.
problem.pain2Desc: Most publicly listed deals in Italy and Portugal are poorly presented. Revenue figures with no context. Brokers who don't respond.
problem.pain3Quote: I didn't even know what I didn't know.
problem.pain3Desc: Finding the right legal and financial professionals for an SME acquisition in a foreign market is its own project.

features.heading: Deals you can evaluate quickly, before you commit your time.
features.feat1Desc: Every listing has a written description, headline financial metrics, and clear context, authored by Bottega, not copy-pasted from the seller. You can self-qualify in minutes, not weeks.
features.feat2Desc: Full financial detail is available after an initial conversation. We protect sellers, which means the numbers you eventually see are real, not sanitised.
features.feat3Desc: Express interest through the platform. No cold calls, no broker gatekeeping. Bottega routes your enquiry and follows up directly.
features.feat4Desc: We source deals directly from founders: manufacturing clusters in northern Italy, service businesses in Lisbon and Porto, food producers across both countries. Markets most platforms underserve.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Body: Bottega Ventures Lda is the operator of this platform. We connect business owners in Italy and Portugal with qualified buyers. Our registered address and contact details are available on request at privacy@bottegaventures.com.
privacyPage.s2Body: For sellers: business name (optional), country, region, sector, year founded, email address, phone number, and business description. For buyers: name, email address, phone number (optional), and enquiry message. We also collect basic usage data (page views, browser type) via analytics.
privacyPage.s3Body: Seller information is used to create and publish your listing on Bottega and to contact you about your listing. Buyer information is used to route your enquiry to the relevant seller and to follow up on your behalf. We do not use your information for advertising or sell it to third parties.
privacyPage.s4Body: Seller contact details and sensitive information are shared only with buyers who have signed a confidentiality agreement. Buyer enquiry information (name, email, message) is shared with the relevant seller. We use Supabase (EU-hosted) for data storage and may use Resend for transactional email.
privacyPage.s5Body: Listing data is retained for as long as your listing is active, plus 12 months after withdrawal. Enquiry data is retained for 24 months. You may request deletion at any time by emailing privacy@bottegaventures.com.
privacyPage.s6Body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also object to processing or request a copy of your data in a portable format. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@bottegaventures.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.
privacyPage.s7Body: We use session cookies required for the platform to function. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies. Analytics data is aggregated and not linked to individual users.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.s1Body: Bottega is a deal presentation platform. We help business owners create structured listing pages and put them in front of qualified buyers. We are not a broker, agent, or financial advisor. We do not take success fees, hold client funds, or represent either party in a transaction.
termsPage.s2Body: By submitting a listing, you confirm that the information provided is accurate and not misleading. You are responsible for the content of your listing. Bottega may edit listings for clarity and presentation, but the underlying facts remain your responsibility. Do not include information that is confidential, defamatory, or legally restricted.
termsPage.s3Body: By submitting an enquiry, you confirm that you are a genuine prospective buyer with the financial capacity to complete an acquisition. You agree not to contact sellers outside the Bottega platform or to share listing information with third parties without prior written consent.
termsPage.s4Body: Bottega does not guarantee that any listing will result in a completed transaction. We do not verify the accuracy of seller-provided financials. All buyers are advised to conduct independent due diligence before making any acquisition decision.
termsPage.s5Body: Bottega reserves the right to remove any listing that contains inaccurate, misleading, or inappropriate content, or that violates these terms. Sellers may withdraw their listing at any time by contacting us.
termsPage.s6Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Bottega is not liable for any loss or damage arising from the use of this platform, reliance on listing content, or the outcome of any transaction. Our total liability to any user shall not exceed the fees paid by that user in the 12 months preceding the claim.
termsPage.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lisbon, Portugal.
